title: CERTIFICATION OF SUPERVISED DRIVING

certification.title: CERTIFICATION
certification.text: I certify that I am the parent/guardian of the applicant, or that I am at least 21 years of age and hold a valid New Jersey driver’s license, and that I accompanied and supervised the applicant during practice driving hours. I certify that the applicant has completed a minimum of 50 hours of supervised driving, including 10 hours during darkness.

signatures.label: Print Name of Parent, Guardian, or Supervising Driver
Signature of Parent, Guardian, or Supervising Driver

certification.extra_text: Please print and sign by hand prior to visiting an Agency

notes: The form has no applicant-name or totals fields; the student's name appears only in this copy's footer.
